I'm building an internal super app for my company.

What I love about building my own software: I can add any damn toggle I want. Toggles that would never ship in software sold to millions because they're too niche. Because... the niche is my company. The software is mine. I don't need permission.

So I can make every action an employee takes PAINFULLY OBVIOUS... AND REQUIRED.

Yes, there's a learning curve to using Claude Code to build software for your company. But it beats teaching every employee how to use someone else's software.

Notion is the example (sorry, I pick on them a lot). If Notion is your company's database, notes and wiki, you have to teach everyone Notion. Databases with pages with databases with linked pages... the list goes on. 

When I build software for my company, the goal is to make the software irrelevant. Only the task matters. Claude can change anything, but employees only see what they need.

Notion was the first notes app to kind of expose the main primitives. Everything is a database with pages with blocks etc. and that comes with a learning curve. 

Convex / Supabase is one layer below that. Give Claude a Convex key and it can build any app you want. When i want something from Notion... I Add it. From any other app? Add it. 

12 months ago my workflow included Notion, MyMind, Excaladraw, Typefully / Buffer, VidIQ, and Google Drive. 

Well... I took all the features from those apps that I liked and added it to my own company super app 

"Native Note". 

(Still have yet to touch a line of code in my life btw)

text: 体验波场抗量子

quoted_tweet.author: May
quoted_tweet.text:
私钥从 64 个字符变成 2560 个，TRON 抗量子钱包有什么不同 ？

TRON 的 Nile 测试网已经支持抗量子签名。现在普通用户也能创建抗量子钱包，领取测试币，亲手完成一笔转账。

01｜变化从密钥开始

普通 Ethereum、TRON 钱包的私钥通常是 64 个十六进制字符，未压缩公钥约为 130 个。TRON 的 FN-DSA-512 方案，公钥为 1792 个字符，私钥为 2560 个。数字差距背后，是密钥结构和签名算法的变化。

02｜地址格式不变，转账依然熟悉

收款地址依然是熟悉的 T 开头，转账仍是填写地址、金额并确认。区别在于，链上节点会使用抗量子算法验证交易。底层安全机制升级，用户不必重新学习一套交易方式。

03｜FN-DSA-512 提前应对量子风险

FN-DSA-512（Falcon-512）采用基于格的密码学，与普通钱包使用的椭圆曲线签名不同。足够强大的量子计算机可能破解后者依赖的数学难题，而针对前者，目前没有已知的高效量子破解算法。抗量子的关键，在数学基础，而不只是密钥长度。

04｜签名更紧凑，兼顾实际使用

传统 ECDSA 签名约 65 字节，TRON 的 FN-DSA-512 签名为 617—667 字节，明显小于 ML-DSA-44 的 2420 字节。在后量子方案中选择更紧凑的签名，有助于控制交易体积，兼顾安全性与实用性。

现在在 TRON ，抗量子签名已经进入可以亲手体验的测试阶段。面向量子时代的安全准备，TRON 已经迈出了切实的一步。
